label: u/d (also o, 0) input at original position 2 or 3
explanation: Fires almost only on the original-phase input at positions 2 and 3 (t=2: 59% of mass, t=3: 41%); it never fires at t=0,1 or t>=5, and never in the copy phase. A tiny amount (1%) lands on <DEL> when L=3. Within those positions the input token decides it: u (54% of mass, 77% of t=2/3 u steps active) and d (25%) dominate, then o, 0, c, f, 2 contribute weakly. The strongest activations are u at t=3 after first tokens like z/f (e.g. z z j [u]). Earlier context also matters: lift is higher when the first token is z, s, b, f or e and when the input is the first occurrence of that token, but these effects are not cleanly separable. Predicate u/d at t in {2,3}: dev F1 0.64, mass recall 0.79; adding o and 0 brings mass recall to 0.93 but precision falls to 0.41.
